summary: Frontend-only test of the redesigned Stock Reports screen (/app/frontend/app/stocks/reports.tsx). All four sections render correctly: (1) summary strip (₹13.0L / 1,240 SKUs / 4.2x), (2) Stock Value Trend SVG area+line chart with +6.4% pill and Jan..Jun labels, (3) Value by Category SVG donut with ₹13.00L center and legend (Electronics 40% / Apparel 26% / Grocery 20% / Hardware 14%), and (4) All Reports list with 7 links. Verified SVG rendering (2 <svg>, 2 <path>, 11 <circle> nodes). All 7 report links navigate to their correct existing routes with NO 'Unmatched Route'. Header back chevron correctly returns from /stocks/reports to /stocks. No pageerrors and no red-screen. Two console warnings are non-blocking react-native-web polyfill noise (deprecated `pointerEvents` prop and `transform-origin` from react-native-svg <G rotation origin=...>) — reports.tsx itself uses `pointerEvents="none"` on the donut center overlay.

issues: Minor: reports.tsx uses `<View pointerEvents="none">` prop (line 167) which is deprecated on RN-web — should be moved to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}`. Not blocking rendering.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated `pointerEvents` prop on <View> — RN-web warns to move it into style. Reference: /app/frontend/app/stocks/reports.tsx:167

Console warning on web: 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' emitted by <G rotation={-90} origin="..."/> in Donut. Non-blocking (donut still renders correctly). Reference: /app/frontend/app/stocks/reports.tsx:78

action_items: (Optional / low-priority) Migrate `pointerEvents="none"` to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` on the donut center overlay View in /app/frontend/app/stocks/reports.tsx:167 to silence the RN-web deprecation warning.
(Optional) The `transform-origin` warning comes from react-native-svg <G rotation origin=.../> and is a known library-level RN-web quirk — safe to ignore or filed as a note.
critical_code_review_comments: Divisions by zero are guarded (`|| 1` for compTotal, range), good.
TrendAreaChart width uses `SW - SPACING.md*2 - SPACING.md*2` — this correctly accounts for outer scroll padding + card padding; renders full-bleed and visible.

All 7 REPORTS routes match existing screen files under /app/frontend/app/stocks/ — verified against the directory listing (stock-ledger, valuation-summary, expiry-schedule, fast-slow, transfer-history, stock-snapshot, negative-stock).
Text-transform 'uppercase' on 'All Reports' label — visible on screen as 'ALL REPORTS'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach the Stock Reports screen: 1) set localStorage.auth_token='mock_token_123' and reload, 2) tap 'Skip' on onboarding, 3) tap 'Stocks' bottom tab, 4) tap 'Stock Reports' row. NOTE: Do NOT use page.goto() directly to /stocks/reports — the RootLayout uses a module-level `_onboardingShownThisSession` flag that resets on every full page reload, causing a redirect to /onboarding. Always dismiss onboarding first, then SPA-navigate via tab taps.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All four review requirements verified: (1) all four sections render, (2) all 7 links land on real screens, (3) header back returns to /stocks, (4) SVG charts render (2 svg / 2 path / 11 circle nodes visible in DOM & screenshots).
